qualified_claims: The actual pinned iMOD Coupler RibaMod driver ran with real MODFLOW 6.7.0 and Ribasim 2026.1.1 through four 6-hour product steps.
MODFLOW and Ribasim product times were exactly 21600, 43200, 64800 and 86400 seconds at the observed boundaries.

For the isolated no-groundwater-exchange topology, the actual product route and a fresh direct RibasimWrapper route produced identical logged Basin levels and cumulative UserDemand deliveries at every 6-hour boundary.
With allocation.dt=24 h, the lower-priority external UserDemand remained unsupplied throughout day 1 despite 6-hour product updates.
The actual RibaMod driver therefore adds no hidden within-day UserDemand management-clock behavior beyond the bundled Ribasim v2026.1.1 release for this isolated topology.
interpretation: DUMMY-20A source authority and DUMMY-20B release-clock authority are dynamically confirmed in the actual product route. RibaMod's 6-hour MF6 cadence advances Ribasim physical time but does not itself create additional fixed-allocation.dt UserDemand decisions.
boundaries: Groundwater exchange is deliberately inactive in this clock-isolation experiment.
This does not establish production SWAP5 product integration or an upstream SWAP5 driver.
This does not transfer v2026.1.1 clock semantics to later Ribasim versions.
No general claim for all Ribasim managed component types.
downstream: Execute prospectively frozen DUMMY-20D actual-product allocation.dt × saveat clock-ownership matrix.
